title: Live/Dead qPCR of B. pertussis IS481
author: Iain MacArthur
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc5niy5e
materials: Briefly spin tube to recover condensation.
Run analysis on data using StepOnePlus™ Software v2.3.
Outliers of triplicate samples should be ignored (omit).

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Pellet fresh samples and resuspend in PBS.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 2,000 x g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend pellet in 1.2 ml of PBS.

steps.title: Sample Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Divide the resuspended sample into two clear microfuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200µl of resuspended sample into each of the two tubes.

steps.title: PMA Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat one of the 200µl samples with PMA to differentiate live from dead cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5µl of PMA to one sample.
Cover samples with aluminium foil and incubate on a rocker in the dark for 10 min at room temperature.
Expose samples to light using the PMA-Lite™ LED Photolysis Device for 5 min.

steps.title: DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the samples using a spin column protocol.

substeps.instruction: Add 20µl of QIAGEN Protease and 4 µl of RNase A.
Add 200µl of Buffer AL and vortex for 15 s.
Incubate at 56ºC for 10 min.
Add 200µl of ethanol (96-100%), vortex, and spin briefly.
Add to spin column and centrifuge for 1 min at 6000xg.
Transfer to a new collection tube.
Add 500µl AW1 buffer and spin for 1 min at 6000xg.
Transfer to a new collection tube.
Add 500µl AW2 buffer and spin for 3 min at 17000xg.
Transfer to a 2ml microfuge tube and spin at max speed for 1 min.
Transfer to a 1.5ml microfuge tube.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Add 200µl of Buffer AE and incubate at room temperature for 1 min.
Elute by centrifuging for 1 min at 6000xg.

steps.title: Primer and Probe Preparation
steps.instruction: Dilute stock primers and probes to working concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Dilute stock primers (50µM) 9 in 50µl to reach a reaction concentration of 900nm.
Dilute stock probe (50µM) 3 in 100µl to reach a reaction concentration of 150nm.

steps.title: qPCR Plate Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the qPCR reaction plate and standards.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Mastermix and add 16µl of master mix per well.
Serial dilute positive control DNA (25ng/ul) 9 times, 5:50.
Load 4µl of DNA in triplicate for each control dilution, unknown, and water samples.
Cover plate with film and spin for 1 min at 1000xg.

steps.title: qPCR Run and Analysis
steps.instruction: Run the qPCR program and calculate the number of live/dead B. pertussis.

substeps.instruction: Set up and run the qPCR program.
Confirm the standard curve has an r 2 >0.95.
Convert pg of DNA to copy number using the formula: B. pertussis /sample=(50x(mass of template in pg)x6.022x10 23 )/length of genome in bp*1x10 12 x650).
Determine total B. pertussis from the untreated sample (no PMA).
Determine live B. pertussis from the PMA treated sample.
Calculate the number of dead cells by finding the difference between untreated and treated samples.
